A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Ishi Tib''' [[Technician/Legends|technician]] served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]] in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]. While at [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 7]], the [[Ishi Tib/Legends|Ishi Tib]] witnessed an explosion of a [[Bota/Legends|bota]] [[Carrier/Legends|carrier]] and, together with a [[Unidentified clone trooper lieutenant (Drongar)|clone]] and a [[Unidentified Human (Drongar)|Human]] speculated what had caused the explosion.
